highlights.reason_zh: 默认认证关闭使关键路径穿越直接威胁可达服务器，已有正式补丁应立即升级。
highlights.reason_en: Critical path traversal threatens reachable servers with authentication off by default, and a formal patch is ready.

highlights.reason_zh: 客户通知缩小了数据暴露路径，直接改变模型路由的供应链风险判断。
highlights.reason_en: Customer notices narrow exposure paths and materially change model-routing supply-chain risk.

highlights.reason_zh: 750B 规模循环架构已进入编码产品，但 API 和权重缺失限制了独立验证。
highlights.reason_en: A 750B-scale looped architecture reaches coding products, while missing API and weights block independent checks.

highlights.reason_zh: 五种规模与量化权重降低了本地电商多模态试验门槛。
highlights.reason_en: Five sizes and quantized weights lower the barrier to local commerce-multimodal trials.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 36/36 成功并完成阅读；主动覆盖模型/API、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文材料、小团队与重大综合新闻。定向补漏找回 GPT-Live-1.1 与 MONAI Label 0.8.6；召回自检补录 LingSante-3.1-flash。NVIDIA CEO 复职作为第五条重大综合新闻仅写入双语日报；GLM-5.4 与 GPT-Live-1.1 只有日期精度，厂商 benchmark 尚待独立复现。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read. Active discovery covered models and APIs, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese-language sources, small teams and exceptional general news. The gap review recovered GPT-Live-1.1 and MONAI Label 0.8.6, and recall audit recovered LingSante-3.1-flash. NVIDIA CEO reinstatement is the fifth combined highlight and appears only in the bilingual daily; GLM-5.4 and GPT-Live-1.1 have date-only precision, and publisher benchmarks await independent reproduction.
